s1.desc: a bathroom with a sink, drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: a bathroom with round washbasins on ice-brick stands, drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a faucet, two small igloo-shaped taps and a glass of water on the counter in front of her

beats.text: Polly brushes her teeth at the sink with her eyes closed and a calm smile
Polly sets her toothbrush down by the faucet and looks ahead
Polly spits a thin stream of water down from her beak into the sink
Polly lifts the glass and gulps water from it with her eyes closed, then lowers it
Polly stands at the sink with her beak shut, staring ahead, then glances down
Polly spits another stream of water down into the sink
